title: ornithogalum unifolium subsp. concinnum
intro: Ornithogalum unifolium subsp. concinnum, commonly known as the Single-Leaf Star Grass or Ornithogalum, is a species of flowering plant in the Asparagaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its antispasmodic and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ornithogalum unifolium subsp. concinnum include its ability to relax the smooth muscles and increase mucus production, helping to relieve respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
